intent.purpose: A household learns what an ambient lighting hub does, sees how setup works, picks a kit and joins the pre-order waitlist.
intent.audience: A prospective buyer furnishing a home
intent.successCriteria: A visitor understands the hub, sees setup and a day of light, picks a kit and joins the waitlist in three pages

theme.direction: Dark evening stage, cream ink, one amber light for action, glass panels

surfaces.name: Home
surfaces.purpose: The claim and the hub, an evening in 40 seconds, tonight’s readouts, three ideas, a beta voice, the lamp makers, one call

surfaces.name: How it works
surfaces.purpose: Setup in four steps, one room in the morning, at dusk and at night, what the hub does on its own

surfaces.name: Kits
surfaces.purpose: Three kits paid once, each with its own button that preselects the kit; beta voices, questions, the waitlist (WaitlistEntry records with the kit), the demo flat
